explication: Afrog is a Go security-scanning toolkit for bug bounty, pentest, and red-team work. In its principal CLI workflow, an operator supplies targets and scan options; the runner performs discovery and fingerprinting, executes built-in or custom PoCs, and emits findings and reports. The repository also exposes scanning through a gRPC API and an embeddable SDK, plus a web console and licensed curated-PoC support. Connections below rely on README statements and the supplied source excerpts or index; unsampled implementation details are not asserted.
